plan: This is a second-price auction where bidding my true value is the dominant strategy. If I win, I pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid, so bidding above my value risks negative profit if I win at a price above my value, while bidding below risks losing profitable opportunities. Bidding exactly my value of $6 ensures I only win when profitable (price paid < my value) and never overpay. This is the optimal, risk-free strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction.

This is a second-price auction, where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of other bidders' actions. If I win, I pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid, so bidding above my value adds risk without benefit, and bidding below my value risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior round history to adjust for opponent behavior, the optimal strategy is to bid exactly my true value of $40, ensuring I maximize expected profit.
